blocks.text: 05-SET / store setup Goes here. Technical setup and configuration for a Shopify store, including creating the account, installing developer environments (Node.js, Git, Shopify CLI), integrating Claude Code via API, managing products (titles, descriptions, pricing, variants, collections), configuring shipping zones and tax settings, generating legal policy pages, and connecting custom domains. Not here. • Writing high-converting copy or structuring landing page layout -> 07-LPG • Using AI to generate ad creatives or marketing assets -> 10-MCR • Configuring Shopify email marketing flows -> 14-EML

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the exact technical pipeline for installing a headless AI development environment (Node + Git + Shopify CLI) to interface Claude Code directly with a live Shopify store theme. modules: [SET] topics: [Shopify setup, Claude Code integration, developer environments, product management, shipping configuration] tier: 3 scope_hint: baseline

Topics. store configuration / activating Shopify plans, creating custom domains, setting up Shopify Payments; developer environments / installing Node.js (bypassing native modules), installing Git, executing Shopify CLI via PowerShell/Terminal (npm install -g @shopify/cli@latest); AI integration / installing Claude Code (irm [https://claude.ai/install.ps1](https://claude.ai/install.ps1) | iex), authenticating the workspace, executing theme pulls (shopify theme pull --store [store-name] --live); product management / generating AI titles/descriptions, setting inventory thresholds, adding variants (size/color), and grouping products into manual collections; back-office settings / configuring free shipping zones (e.g., $10 minimum for standard 5-8 day delivery), activating the Shopify tax service, and generating templated legal policies (Refund, Privacy, Terms of Service).

The CLI Integration Stack: The exact sequence of installing Node.js, Git, and the Shopify CLI to bridge the local computer environment with the live Shopify store, enabling Claude Code to manipulate the theme files.
Theme Extraction: Using the command shopify theme pull --store [domain] --live to copy the store's current theme into a local directory so Claude can read and edit the code.
Local Dev Server Preview: Utilizing the local development server to preview Claude's code changes in real-time (privately) before pushing them live to the public Shopify theme.
Skip. Promotional links for Shopify trials, generic advice about "asking Claude to make it look good," and superficial UI walkthroughs.
Scope mix. 10% baseline (basic Shopify settings like shipping/taxes), 90% growth (advanced CLI and headless AI integration). Volume. ~400 words.

07-LPG / landing pages Goes here. Briefing Claude Code on landing page design, compiling inspiration screenshots, structuring the hero section, featured products, and customer reviews, and polishing the final layout. Not here. • The technical installation of the Shopify CLI and Claude Code -> 05-SET

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Explains how to structure a prompt architecture for Claude Code to build a landing page section-by-section, using structured local file directories as visual inspiration. modules: [LPG] topics: [AI web design, prompt architecture, page structuring, inspiration directories] tier: 2 scope_hint: growth

Topics. inspiration sourcing / reviewing the Shopify theme library, capturing screenshots of desired sections (hero, product display, story, reviews), organizing local asset directories (images, logos, screenshots); prompt architecture / guiding the AI to build section-by-section rather than all at once, defining visual styles (e.g., clean, neutral, loud); page types and section order / Hero section, Shop by Category, Featured Products (forcing the AI to use live store products), Customer Reviews, Our Story; friction removal / adding easing animations to reduce harsh load times, polishing headers (hamburger menus) and footers.

The Inspiration Directory Strategy: Creating a local folder containing screenshots of competitors or desired themes, alongside raw product photos and logos, and feeding that entire directory to Claude Code to establish strict visual parameters before building.

Section-by-Section Prompting: Instructing Claude to build the Hero section first, pausing for review on the local dev server, requesting specific tweaks (e.g., "add an easing animation so elements fade in on scroll"), and only proceeding to the next section once approved.
Skip. The exact PowerShell commands used to install the software.
Scope mix. 100% growth (using AI to design landing pages). Volume. ~250 words.
